title: user registration should create new user successfully
description: Test the /api/v1/auth/register/ endpoint to ensure it creates a new user with valid username and password, returns status 201, and includes user ID and username in the response.

title: user login should authenticate and return jwt tokens
description: Test the /api/v1/auth/login/ endpoint to verify that valid username and password return access and refresh JWT tokens with status 200, and invalid credentials return 401.

title: place list should support filtering pagination and sorting
description: Test the /api/v1/places/ GET endpoint to verify it returns a paginated list of places filtered by search keyword, city, and category, and supports ordering with correct results.

title: place search should return results matching query
description: Test the /api/v1/places/search/ GET endpoint to ensure it returns search results matching the required query parameter 'q' with status 200.

title: place detail should return detailed information or 404
description: Test the /api/v1/places/{id}/ GET endpoint to verify it returns detailed place information for a valid place ID with status 200, and returns 404 for non-existent place IDs.

title: travel plan preview should generate plan using ai agents
description: Test the /api/v1/travel-plans/preview/ GET endpoint to verify it generates a travel plan preview with required parameters origin, destination, and days, returning detailed transport, accommodation, activities, and budget information.

title: travel plan create should save plan with valid data
description: Test the /api/v1/travel-plans/ POST endpoint to ensure it creates and saves a travel plan with required fields, returning status 201 on success and appropriate errors for invalid input.

title: step1 location selection should validate locations and return distance
description: Test the /api/v1/travel-plans/step1/ POST endpoint to verify it validates origin and destination locations, returns distance in km, estimated duration, and recommended transport with status 200.

title: step3 budget suggestion should return budget based on preferences
description: Test the /api/v1/travel-plans/step3/ POST endpoint to ensure it returns budget suggestions based on origin, destination, days, travelers, and travel style, with status 200.

title: analytics should return aggregate data about places users and itineraries
description: Test the /api/v1/analytics/ GET endpoint to verify it returns aggregate analytics data including total places, total users, and total itineraries with status 200.
